cover.pressQuote: An artist of inexhaustible imagination and rare conceptual ambition—Brennan is redefining what the vibraphone can be and do. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Vibraphonist Patricia Brennan makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with her Tentet in Of The Near And Far—a program in which she mapped constellations onto a musical Circle of Fifths, finding inspiration in the geometries of the stars themselves.
body: Wonder and discovery take center stage at the Museum of Science when vibraphonist Patricia Brennan makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with her Tentet. In Of The Near And Far, Brennan mapped constellations onto a musical Circle of Fifths diagram, finding inspiration in the geometries of the stars themselves and in humanity's search for meaning in chaos. Humanity has always looked to the sky for meaning. Brennan found her music amongst the cosmos, bringing it down to share with the world.
